title: Destructuring Method Parameters
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of destructuring method parameters in a Ruby program and name the key rule involved.
Apply destructuring method parameters in a small example and predict its result before running it.
Identify one boundary or failure case related to handling structured inputs and verify the intended behavior.

content.intro: Learn Destructuring Method Parameters through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding destructuring method parameters helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Destructuring Method Parameters helps you reason about multiple assignment in parameters. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Multiple assignment in parameters. Then connect it to Nested structures. The remaining syllabus points—Handling structured inputs—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.

content_blocks.title: Guided example
content_blocks.text: Run the example as written, compare it with the expected result, and explain why each line supports destructuring method parameters. Next change one input or condition and predict the result before running it.

content_blocks.text: Create a second example for destructuring method parameters using a different input. Add one edge case from the syllabus list (Handling structured inputs), state the expected behavior, and write a small test or manual check that would catch a regression.
